content:
maria (product): Quick heads up — we are publishing Data Locality Policy v1.2 for Private/VPC/On‑Prem today. Short summary: region-lock toggle for tenants, new on‑prem agent self‑certification flow, and an offline attestation option for HSM/KMS setups. APAC availability will start next week in two waves. Docs + compliance pack updated here: https://internal.redwood/docs/data-locality-v1.2 — please skim and escalate blockers.
ashwin (eng): Is telemetry default changing for new installs or existing customers? Also what’s the migration window?

maria (product): Good q. New on‑prem installs will default to telemetry opt‑out-by-default (per enterprise feedback). Existing installs are unchanged unless customer requests migration. We’ll run a scheduled migration path with a 30‑day notice for customers who opt in; migration details in the doc.

claudia (security): Note: self‑cert flow includes an offline signing path so customers who cannot reach our attestation endpoint can still get certified. We added an attestation checklist for SOC2/FedRAMP conversations — see section 4.2.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: onprem-docs-v1.2 -> staging (CI #4523). ETA 18:00 UTC. :gear:

jordan (ceo): Thanks for moving fast. Priority: ensure CSM + sales get one‑pager by EOD so no surprises in customer calls. :thumbsup:

alex (solutions): I’ll run two customer readiness webinars (Tue/Thu next week). Need slide deck + FAQ. Who wants to own the FAQ draft?

maria (product): I’ll start the FAQ. Action items below. Also pasting the minimal agent config snippet customers will need:

```yaml
agent:
  version: "3.2.0"
  telemetry:
    default: "opt_out"
  attest:
    hardware_backed: true
    offline_signing: true
```

maria (product): Action items: @ops (ashwin) publish release note + migration plan; @legal (claudia) confirm contract/terms wording for region lock; @prod-comms (alex) draft external email + webinar invites; @oncall (ops-bot) monitor staging rollout and flag any doc regressions. I’ll coordinate PM side.

ashwin (eng): Taking ops release notes + rollout checklist. I’ll add the migration cron and rollback steps to runbook.

claudia (security): I’ll review customer wording by tomorrow morning and flag anything risky.

alex (solutions): Will draft the deck and share by EOD for review. Will also include example customer messaging variations (SMB vs enterprise).

maria (product): Thanks all. If you’re listed above please update the tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/PRIV-LOC-112. Close comments here unless blocking issues. :tada:
